| `phenotype.case_rule` | documentation_derived | V-23a. Thresholds follow the 2017 ACC/AHA guideline categories (acc_aha_bp_2017; stage 1 >=130 systolic or >=80 diastolic, from secondary summaries; the >=2 readings on >=2 occasions rule must be confirmed in the primary text). EHR operationalization follows Teixeira 2017 (teixeira_2017_htn): BP readings, diagnosis codes, and medications in combination. Medications alone never establish a case (antihypertensives have other indications). All provisional. |
| `phenotype.control_rule` | documentation_derived | V-23b. Controls: >=2 normal systolic (<130) and diastolic (<80) readings on distinct days, no reading >=140/90, no hypertension diagnosis, no antihypertensive medication (provisional). |
